fields.description:
## Source of truth

https://jumpr.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/JK/pages/269090817/03+User+Stories+Jira+Disposition

## Outcome

Ops/support can see and diagnose CMS failures without developer investigation for ordinary errors.

## Requirements

* Current failure state lives on Deal sync fields from WAGR-451.
* Enable Field History on key sync state/result fields where capacity permits.
* Reports/list views include at minimum:

    * CMS Sync Failed;
    * Pending/Retrying beyond expected threshold;
    * eligible Deals never successfully synced;
    * recently Synced.
    
* Group reports in a CMS Sync folder; dashboard counts may surface the same status groups.
* On terminal/exhausted failure, notify configured recipients.
* Prefer one summary notification per run/batch where multiple Deals fail rather than one email per Deal.
* 401/route/config failures alert immediately.
* Diagnostic notification should include where available:

    * Deal Id/Name/External ID;
    * exact outbound **business payload**;
    * HTTP status;
    * CMS response/error body;
    * attempt count;
    * timestamp;
    * Salesforce record link;
    * recommended next action if known.
    
* Timeout/Flow/Apex faults may have no HTTP response; still include payload and exception context.
* Never include credentials/secrets.
* Recipients are configuration-driven.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Mixed failed run creates visible Deal failures and one useful summary notification.
2. 401 creates immediate alert.
3. Exhausted retry creates final failure/notification.
4. Timeout without response still provides actionable context.
5. Reports return the expected records from staging test data.
6. No-failure run sends no failure notification.
7. V1 works without a dedicated per-call Integration Log object.

## Dependencies

* WAGR-451.
* WAGR-454.
* WAGR-493 for config/permissions as needed.
